name: Grendel
definition: A distributed system designed to partition 3DGS parameters and parallelize computation across multiple GPUs to handle high-resolution and large-scale 3D reconstruction tasks limited by single-GPU memory constraints.
summary: Grendel is a distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting training system that overcomes single-GPU memory limits using sparse all-to-all communication and dynamic load balancing to handle high-resolution scenes.
